name: David Vincent
location: In and around Sanderstead, South Croydon
bio: David began practising yoga in April 2022. What started as an interest became a lasting passion for movement, breath and the philosophy behind the practice. Alongside his career in investment banking, he is developing an independent teaching practice centred on personal attention and consistent, thoughtful learning.

classes.title: One-to-one practice
classes.description: Space to focus on you. A personal session shaped around your experience, interests and the practice you want to build.

classes.title: Small-group practice
classes.description: Practise together in a welcoming, intimate setting, with room for individual guidance and shared encouragement.

classes.title: Ashtanga Yoga
classes.description: Explore a progressive sequence of postures, connecting a steady breath with purposeful movement.

classes.title: Dharma Yoga
classes.description: An exploration of posture, breathing, concentration and meditation, informed by the holistic Dharma Yoga approach.

classes.title: Your first practice
classes.description: An unhurried introduction. Get comfortable with the fundamentals, ask questions and find a starting point that suits you.

venue_note: The exact hall or studio will be confirmed before your session.
qualification: David holds a recognised yoga teaching certification from The Yoga People.
training_school_registration: a Yoga Alliance Registered Yoga School

pricing.summary: Private sessions start from £40. Small-group sessions are approximately £30 per person. Final prices, duration and availability are confirmed when you enquire.
